title: tunna percent-encoding vectors
description: Oracles for the canonical encoding of path segments, whole paths, and query strings. An encoder passes when every case's output matches byte for byte.

kind.description: segment: input is one decoded path segment, expected is its encoding. path: input is a decoded path split into segments (array), expected is the canonical path. query: input is an array of [name, value] decoded pairs in any order, expected is the canonical query string.
